sources.title: Authorized defensive cybersecurity
sources.supports: General-purpose/frontier models can support authorized defensive investigations and patch validation.

sources.title: Cybersecurity safeguards
sources.supports: Some legitimate defensive requests may be flagged; this does not establish universal refusal.

sources.title: Cloud enterprise data controls
sources.supports: Eligible customers can configure retention controls. Local inference should not be presented as the only possible privacy control.

sources.title: Cloud API limits and capacity options
sources.supports: APIs can have quotas and transient overload responses; enterprise capacity tiers are also available. This does not support an inevitable cloud scarcity prediction.

sources.title: HP ZGX Fury
sources.supports: Fury is positioned for shared local AI development, inference and agentic workloads.

comparison_policy: Cloud lane is a timed scripted fictional customer-policy request check, then scenario DENIED. No cloud API call, evidence upload or fabricated provider result. Local evidence analysis is real; city recovery and human queue are explicitly simulated. Capacity planning is a customer-specific evaluation, not a prediction of inevitable cloud scarcity or guaranteed local availability.
